name: The Hierophant
bio: One of the twenty-two dark Major Arcana hanging in the sky of NEON ARCANA. Lights up when lines clear.

portrait.subject: a cute cyber-mystic tarot character with a glowing neon cyan robe, a holographic tiara, circuit-pattern sleeves and a floating glowing glyph
portrait.background: dark tech-magic sky with neon tarot cards

request: The Hierophant, card V of NEON ARCANA. The magic's gone dark. Light it with me? 🔮
hello: The lattice glows a little brighter.
Fill a row, and it bursts into light.
about: I am the Hierophant. The twenty-two Major Arcana hang dark in the sky. Every line you clear lights us back up.
how: Drag glyphs from your hand of three onto an 8×8 lattice; fill a whole row or column to burst it into light.
tips: Keep the centre open for big glyphs.
Two lines at once = combo light.
chat: The Tower blinked at me today. Ominous.
My hologram flickered. Needs a reboot.
Neon and magic. The best combination.
The Star is almost lit again!
nudge: Another Arcana is close to waking!
idle: The lattice has been empty for {ago}.
update: NEON ARCANA updated to v{version}. New glyphs glow.
